_note: Planning requests need no assignment. analyze-ui also takes capture_ref, targets, manifests, image_sinks (the project's picture-loading methods) and layout_helpers (its layout-parameter builders, one row per arity with the unit of a bare number); for a web or Harmony legacy it takes platform (web|harmony) with capture_ref and targets only. validate-ui takes ui_tree_ref/source_index_ref/runtime_index_ref and resource_scope. resource-plan and screen-checks take args.dimension_analysis_ref of the staged analysis: the first returns the parameter sheet, the copy plan and what is left to author; the second the image checks every picture use still lacks, with rendered references.
